class.name: SceneTransition
class.description: Created automatically by [SceneManager] under the root viewport; you do not place one in a scene. It shows a configured loading-screen scene (or a plain colour fill) over a fade, forwards load progress to that scene's [code]set_progress[/code] method if it has one, and keeps the screen up for at least [member min_display_time] so fast loads do not flash.

method.name: hide_loading
method.description: Requests the fade back to the game. Honours [member min_display_time].

method.name: is_busy
method.description: True while the transition is anything other than fully hidden.

method.name: is_covered
method.description: True once the screen fully covers the viewport. [SceneManager] waits for this before swapping scenes.

method.name: show_loading
method.description: Fades the screen up. If [code]scene_path[/code] is non-empty it is instanced on top of the backdrop.

members.member: Backdrop colour behind the loading scene, and the fill used when no loading scene is set.
Seconds for the fade in and the fade out.
Minimum seconds the fully-covered screen stays up once loading is done.
